description_en: Kicks a specific user out of a room by calling the KickRoomUser operation
description_zh: 调用KickRoomUser接口，实现对房间内某特定用户实施踢出房间操作
kebab_example: aliyun imp kick-room-user --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id as0000hs --kick-user er0000h --region cn-hangzhou
name: KickRoomUser

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, which is returned when you call the CreateRoom operation
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the kick operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了踢人操作
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the user to be kicked out of the room
parameters.name: kick_user

parameters.help_en:
The duration for which the user is kicked out of the room. The user cannot re-enter the room within this period. Unit: seconds.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 300 seconds.

A value of 0 indicates that the user is permanently kicked out of the room
parameters.help_zh:
踢出房间时长，有效时间内不能再次进入房间，单位：秒。

如果不填写该字段，默认踢出300秒。

传0表示永久踢出房间
parameters.name: block_time
